_comment: Models built into the S25 Ultra APK. Each entry gets its own model library
compiled for android:adreno (Adreno 830), because constants such as
rope_theta and the context/prefill sizes are baked into the kernels.
source=hf:   prebuilt MLC weights, downloaded by the app over HTTPS on first use.
source=convert: converted locally by 20_convert_weights.sh from the original
Hugging Face checkpoint and side-loaded (bundle_weight) over adb.
estimated_vram_bytes is what the app checks before loading; the S25 Ultra
has 12 GB shared RAM, of which ~5 GB is a safe budget next to One UI.
